title: Crvena Zvezda top Partizan to conquer the trophy
description: Crvena Zvezda - Partizan NiS 80-77 Crvena Zvezda have been crowned ABA Liga champions. They topped their archrivals Partizan in the decisive fifth game of the championship series to lift the sixth trophy in the last seven editions of the tournament. The hosts trailed by 4 points at the halftime before their 47-40 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. Crvena Zvezda forced 19 Partizan NiS turnovers. American guard Nate Wolters (193-1991, college: S.Dakota St., agency: Pensack Sports) orchestrated the victory by scoring 12 points and 7 assists. Dejan Davidovac (202-1995, agency: BeoBasket) contributed with 15 points and 6 rebounds for the winners. Four Crvena Zvezda players scored in double figures.
